name: synci
title: Synci
description: Search transactions, check balances and holdings, monitor connections, and ask Raycast AI about your finances with Synci.
author: tonning

commands.name: search-transactions
commands.title: Search Transactions
commands.description: Search transactions across your connected accounts with account and date filters

commands.name: check-balances
commands.title: Check Balances
commands.description: View balances, currency totals, and the latest sync for your accounts

commands.name: view-holdings
commands.title: View Holdings
commands.description: Explore investment and crypto holdings, quantities, market values, and account details

commands.name: recent-spending
commands.title: Show Recent Spending
commands.description: Explore booked outflows by currency, merchant, and account

commands.name: connection-status
commands.title: Open Connection Status
commands.description: Check connection health, consent expiry, and open connections in Synci

commands.name: reconnect-synci
commands.title: Reconnect Synci
commands.description: Choose which Synci accounts Raycast can access and approve updated permissions

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.title: List Accounts
tools.description: Find connected bank, investment, and crypto accounts, their IDs, balance timestamps, and history coverage. Use before querying an account by ID.

tools.name: get-account-balance
tools.title: Get Account Balance
tools.description: Read recent balance snapshots, cash balances, and broker-reported totals for an account. Always report the as_of timestamp and distinguish credit availability from money owned.

tools.name: list-transactions
tools.title: List Transactions
tools.description: Read a page of transactions with date, account, and settlement-status filters. Includes payees, categories, and investment activity. Follow meta.has_more and next_cursor for complete results; check earliest_available_date before calculating totals.

tools.name: list-holdings
tools.title: List Holdings
tools.description: Read investment and crypto positions, quantities, prices, and market values across all permitted accounts or one account. Values reflect the last provider sync.

tools.name: list-connections
tools.title: List Connections
tools.description: Check bank/provider connection health, consent expiry, and sync status. Read-only; connection management happens in Synci.

preferences.name: spendingPeriod
preferences.title: Default Spending Period
preferences.description: Initial time period shown in Recent Spending

preferences.name: showDetails
preferences.title: Transaction Details
preferences.description: Open transactions with a side panel instead of a full-width list. Press Enter on a transaction to view its details.
preferences.label: Show transaction side panel by default

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
